items.title: Germaine Bazzle interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006
items.q: Wynton Marsalis is on a big fundraiser coming up

ctx.x: Well not as dramatic as some people. But I did have the flooding to the extent that we had to gut everything, take out all the walls, even the ceiling, the flooring, because of the water, and had wind damage. Part of my roof was in the driveway and all of that. But that’s able to be repaired. It’s the people whose homes floated down the street, whose homes just collapsed, their situation is far worse than mine. Because in my area now I was very glad to see that my neighbors are coming back and working on their…
I just got a mailing from, I’m not sure, Wynton Marsalis is on a big fundraiser coming up and there’ve been a lot of efforts and I hope that they have positive results for all of you down there.

Yes, yes. Well you know there’s a special thing going on, this Habitat for Humanities is doing a thing for a musician’s village. So they are — and you know that involves sweat equity and all of that kind of thing so that the musicians who are applying, who have applied for a home, they have to come in and do some work, help them in building their homes. So they are about the business of setting up a place so that the musicians can come back. And they’re going to establish a center, an Ellis Marsalis Center in…
